highlights.title: A sign-in no longer stops the whole team
highlights.text: Each bot job gets its own page in the team's browser. A sign-in or CAPTCHA holds only its own page, so the team's other bots keep working. The pages share the team's sign-ins.

highlights.title: See each bot's page in the browser view
highlights.text: When a team has 2 or more pages, a strip above the address bar lists them by bot and site. A page that needs you has a yellow dot, and the view goes to it.

fixes: A team has at most 4 job pages at once. A 5th job waits up to a minute for one to free up, then gets a message that all 4 are in use.
The address bar opens sites on the page you're looking at.
